reason: A conversation-view preview panel that collects agent-produced artifacts and lets users inspect supported HTML, image, SVG, JSON, and Markdown files.

summaries.zh: 在对话视图中提供预览面板，用于查看智能体生成的 HTML、图片、SVG、JSON 和 Markdown 文件。
summaries.en: Adds a conversation-view preview panel for inspecting agent-produced HTML, image, SVG, JSON, and Markdown files.

capabilities: registers a preview tab in the conversation view
reads selected session files through a host RPC
renders HTML, images, SVG, JSON, and Markdown previews
